---
title: "Visium registration validation"
author: "Asier Antoranz"
output:
  html_document:
    df_print: paged
---

Aggregates registered Xenium cells into Visium pseudospots, evaluates the melanoma-weight threshold and imputation agreement, and summarises integration quality and regional composition.

**Inputs:** Visium objects and tables from notebooks 01–02, Xenium counts and final annotations from notebooks 01 and 04, registered coordinates in `paper_data/Registration/Visium`, and raw Visium spatial data.

**Outputs:** Registered pseudospots and their expression in `data/`; threshold, agreement and composition tables in `results/`; diagnostic and spatial panels in `figures/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}

# Set these root folders before running the notebook.
data_root <- 'path_to_input'
output_root <- 'path_to_output'
code_root <- 'path_to_code'

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, cache = FALSE)

```

```{r load_libraries}

library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(ggplot2)

outdir <- file.path(output_root, 'Visium')
input_dir <- file.path(data_root, 'Visium', 'inputs')
raw_dir <- file.path(data_root, 'Visium', 'raw')
intermediate_dir <- file.path(outdir, 'data')
result_dir <- file.path(outdir, 'results')
figure_dir <- file.path(outdir, 'figures')
xenium_dir <- file.path(output_root, 'Xenium', 'data')
for (path in c(outdir, intermediate_dir, result_dir, figure_dir)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
future::plan('sequential')

samples <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir, 'samples.csv'), colClasses = 'character')

source(file.path(code_root, 'Visium', 'helpers.R'), local = TRUE)

```

## Registered Xenium pseudospots

```{r load_registration_inputs}

library(RANN)
registration_root <- file.path(data_root, 'Registration', 'Visium')
spots <- read.csv(file.path(intermediate_dir, 'spot_metadata.csv'))
analysis <- readRDS(file.path(intermediate_dir, 'visium_analysis.rds'))
xenium <- readRDS(file.path(xenium_dir, 'final_annotation.rds'))

```

```{r prepare_registration_files}

manifest <- samples
manifest$visium_file <- file.path(registration_root, manifest$sample, 'visium_cells.csv')
manifest$xenium_file <- file.path(registration_root, manifest$sample, 'xenium_cells.csv')

```

```{r match_cells_to_spots}

pseudospots <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(manifest)), function(i) {
    row <- manifest[i, ]
    barcodes <- sub(".*_", "", spots$spot[spots$sample == row$sample & spots$QC_750_keep])
    v <- read.csv(row$visium_file)
    v <- v[v$barcode %in% barcodes, ]
    x <- read.csv(row$xenium_file)
    x$main_lineage <- xenium$main_lineage[match(x$cell, rownames(xenium))]
    x <- x[!is.na(x$main_lineage), ]
    coordinates <- as.matrix(v[c("x_registered", "y_registered")])
    spacing <- RANN::nn2(coordinates, coordinates, k = 2)$nn.dists[, 2]
    radius <- 27.5/(100/median(spacing))
    neighbors <- RANN::nn2(as.matrix(x[c("x_registered", "y_registered")]), coordinates, searchtype = "radius", 
        k = min(3000, nrow(x)), radius = radius)
    matches <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(v)), function(j) {
        index <- neighbors$nn.idx[j, ]
        index <- index[index > 0]
        if (!length(index)) 
            return(NULL)
        data.frame(barcode = v$barcode[j], cell = x$cell[index], main_lineage = x$main_lineage[index])
    })
    matches <- bind_rows(matches)
    counts <- matches %>% count(barcode, main_lineage)
    list(sample = row$sample, patient = row$patient, radius = radius, matches = matches, lineage_counts = counts, 
        coords = v)
})
names(pseudospots) <- manifest$sample
saveRDS(pseudospots, file.path(intermediate_dir, 'registered_pseudospots.rds'))

```

## Visium melanoma-weight threshold

```{r prepare_threshold_validation}

library(patchwork)
library(tidyr)
weights <- read.csv(file.path(result_dir, 'Visium_cell2location_weights.csv'))

```

```{r quantify_registered_melanoma}

reference <- lapply(pseudospots, function(section) {
    section$matches %>% group_by(barcode) %>% summarise(n_registered = n(), n_melanoma = sum(main_lineage == "Melanoma"), 
        .groups = "drop") %>% mutate(spot = paste0(section$sample, "_", barcode), patient = section$patient, xenium_tumour = n_melanoma >= 
        5 & n_melanoma/n_registered >= 0.25)
})
reference <- bind_rows(reference)
validation <- inner_join(weights %>% select(spot, Melanoma), reference, by = 'spot')

```

```{r evaluate_melanoma_thresholds}

grid <- lapply(seq(0, 1, 0.0025), function(threshold) {
    call <- validation$Melanoma >= threshold
    truth <- validation$xenium_tumour
    TP <- sum(call & truth)
    FP <- sum(call & !truth)
    FN <- sum(!call & truth)
    TN <- sum(!call & !truth)
    precision <- TP/(TP + FP)
    recall <- TP/(TP + FN)
    denominator <- sqrt(as.numeric(TP + FP) * as.numeric(TP + FN) * as.numeric(TN + FP) * as.numeric(TN + FN))
    mcc <- ifelse(denominator == 0, NA_real_, (TP * TN - FP * FN)/denominator)
    data.frame(threshold = threshold, TP, FP, FN, TN, precision, recall, F1 = 2 * precision * recall/(precision + 
        recall), MCC = mcc)
})
grid <- bind_rows(grid)
write.csv(grid, file.path(result_dir, "Supplementary_Figure_13B_thresholds.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r plot_threshold_performance}

plot_data <- grid %>% select(threshold, F1, MCC) %>% pivot_longer(c(F1, MCC), names_to = 'metric', values_to = 'value')
plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(threshold, value, color = metric)) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0.20, linetype = 'dashed', color = 'grey25') + geom_line(linewidth = 0.7, na.rm = TRUE) + scale_color_manual(values = c(F1 = '#0072B2', MCC = '#D55E00')) + labs(x = 'Melanoma-weight threshold', y = 'Performance score', color = NULL) + theme_classic(base_size = 9) + theme(legend.position = 'top')
save_panel(plot, 'Supplementary_Figure_13B_cell2location_threshold.pdf', 4, 3)

```

## Registered Xenium pseudospot expression

```{r load_pseudospot_counts}

pre <- assemble_section_expression(analysis$sections)
xenium <- readRDS(file.path(xenium_dir, 'counts_qc.rds'))
genes <- intersect(rownames(xenium$counts), rownames(pre))
all_cells <- unique(unlist(lapply(pseudospots, function(section) section$matches$cell)))
counts <- xenium$counts[genes, all_cells, drop = FALSE]
rm(xenium)
gc()

```

```{r aggregate_pseudospot_expression}

aggregated <- lapply(pseudospots, function(section) {
    matches <- section$matches
    membership <- factor(matches$barcode, levels = unique(matches$barcode))
    design <- Matrix::sparse.model.matrix(~0 + membership)
    colnames(design) <- levels(membership)
    raw <- counts[, matches$cell, drop = FALSE] %*% design
    library_size <- Matrix::colSums(raw)
    normalised <- raw
    normalised@x <- log1p(normalised@x/rep.int(library_size, diff(normalised@p)) * 10000)
    list(sample = section$sample, patient = section$patient, data = normalised, coords = section$coords, n_cells = table(matches$barcode))
})
saveRDS(aggregated, file.path(intermediate_dir, 'pseudospot_expression.rds'))

```

## Visium integration diagnostics

```{r load_integration_diagnostics}

library(ggrepel)
objects <- analysis$sections
features <- analysis$integration$features
integrated <- analysis$integration

```

```{r embed_unintegrated_spots}

expression <- pre[features, , drop = FALSE]
metadata <- data.frame(spot = colnames(expression), sample = unlist(lapply(objects, function(seu) seu$sample), use.names = FALSE))
scaled <- t(scale(t(as.matrix(expression))))
pca <- RunPCA(object = scaled, npcs = 30, seed.use = 20260802, verbose = FALSE)
umap <- RunUMAP(Embeddings(pca), n.components = 2, n.neighbors = 30, min.dist = 0.30, metric = 'cosine', seed.use = 20260802, verbose = FALSE)

```

```{r test_batch_mixing}

kbet <- function(embedding, batch) {
    set.seed(20260830)
    kBET::kBET(df = embedding[, 1:5], batch = batch, k0 = 30, testSize = 766, do.pca = FALSE, heuristic = FALSE, 
        n_repeat = 100, alpha = 0.05, adapt = TRUE, plot = FALSE, verbose = FALSE)
}
before <- kbet(Embeddings(pca), metadata$sample)
after <- kbet(Embeddings(integrated$reductions[['pca_rpca']]), integrated$metadata$sample)
summary <- data.frame(stage = c('SCTnorm', 'RPCA'), acceptance_rate = 1 - c(before$summary['mean', 'kBET.observed'], after$summary['mean', 'kBET.observed']))
write.csv(summary, file.path(result_dir, "Supplementary_Figure_12F_kBET.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r plot_integration_embeddings}

patient_colors <- setNames(c('#0072B2', '#E69F00', '#009E73', '#CC79A7', '#D55E00', '#56B4E9'), samples$patient)
embedding_plot <- function(coordinates, sample) {
    data <- data.frame(UMAP_1 = coordinates[, 1], UMAP_2 = coordinates[, 2], patient = samples$patient[match(sample, 
        samples$sample)])
    centers <- data %>% group_by(patient) %>% summarise(UMAP_1 = median(UMAP_1), UMAP_2 = median(UMAP_2), .groups = "drop")
    ggplot(data, aes(UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = patient)) + ggrastr::geom_point_rast(size = 0.55, alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0, raster.dpi = 300) + geom_label_repel(data = centers, 
        aes(label = patient), color = "black", fill = scales::alpha("white", 0.9), size = 3.2, linewidth = 0.2, 
        seed = 123, show.legend = FALSE) + scale_color_manual(values = patient_colors) + labs(x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2") + 
        theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(axis.text = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
}
save_panel(embedding_plot(Embeddings(umap), metadata$sample), 'Supplementary_Figure_12D_before_integration.pdf', 4, 4)
save_panel(embedding_plot(Embeddings(integrated$reductions[['umap_rpca']]), integrated$metadata$sample), 'Supplementary_Figure_12E_after_integration.pdf', 4, 4)

```

```{r plot_batch_acceptance}

plot <- ggplot(summary, aes(stage, acceptance_rate, fill = stage)) + geom_col(width = 0.65) + geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(acceptance_rate, accuracy = 0.1)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) + scale_fill_manual(values = c(RPCA = '#BDBDBD', SCTnorm = '#D55E00')) + labs(x = NULL, y = 'kBET acceptance rate') + theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = 'none')
save_panel(plot, 'Supplementary_Figure_12F_kBET.pdf', 4, 4)

```

## Visium spatial imputation check

```{r load_imputation_comparisons}

library(spdep)
post <- analysis$magic

```

```{r test_spatial_agreement}

results <- lapply(names(aggregated), function(sid) {
    section <- aggregated[[sid]]
    keep <- colnames(section$data)
    keep <- keep[section$n_cells[keep] >= 1]
    spots <- intersect(paste0(sid, "_", keep), colnames(pre))
    keep <- sub(paste0(sid, "_"), "", spots)
    coordinates <- section$coords[match(keep, section$coords$barcode), c("x_registered", "y_registered")]
    neighbors <- spdep::knearneigh(as.matrix(coordinates), k = 6)
    weights <- spdep::nb2listw(spdep::knn2nb(neighbors), style = "W")
    rows <- lapply(rownames(section$data), function(gene) {
        x <- as.numeric(section$data[gene, keep])
        a <- as.numeric(pre[gene, spots])
        b <- as.numeric(post[gene, spots])
        data.frame(sample = sid, gene = gene, n_spots = length(x), pearson_pre = suppressWarnings(cor(x, a, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")), 
            pearson_post = suppressWarnings(cor(x, b, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")), lee_pre = tryCatch(spdep::lee(x, 
                a, weights, n = length(x))$L, error = function(e) NA_real_), lee_post = tryCatch(spdep::lee(x, 
                b, weights, n = length(x))$L, error = function(e) NA_real_))
    })
    bind_rows(rows)
})
results <- bind_rows(results) %>% mutate(delta = lee_post - lee_pre)

```

```{r export_imputation_agreement}

results$patient <- samples$patient[match(results$sample, samples$sample)]
write.csv(results, file.path(result_dir, "Visium_spatial_imputation_agreement.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r plot_imputation_agreement}

limits <- range(c(results$lee_pre, results$lee_post), na.rm = TRUE)
mean_pre <- mean(results$lee_pre, na.rm = TRUE)
mean_post <- mean(results$lee_post, na.rm = TRUE)
scatter <- ggplot(results, aes(lee_pre, lee_post, color = delta)) + geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed') + geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.8, stroke = 0, na.rm = TRUE) + scale_color_gradient2(low = '#2166AC', mid = '#E8E8E8', high = '#B2182B', midpoint = 0, limits = c(-0.2, 0.2), oob = scales::squish) + scale_x_continuous(limits = limits) + scale_y_continuous(limits = limits) + coord_equal() + theme_classic(base_size = 11) + theme(legend.position = 'none') + labs(x = "Lee's L (pre)", y = "Lee's L (post)")
top <- ggplot(results, aes(lee_pre)) + geom_density(fill = scales::alpha('#BDBDBD', 0.65), color = '#5F5F5F', linewidth = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) + geom_vline(xintercept = mean_pre, linetype = 'dashed') + annotate('text', x = mean_pre, y = Inf, label = sprintf('mean = %.3f', mean_pre), vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3) + scale_x_continuous(limits = limits) + theme_void()
right <- ggplot(results, aes(lee_post)) + geom_density(fill = scales::alpha('#BDBDBD', 0.65), color = '#5F5F5F', linewidth = 0.5, na.rm = TRUE) + geom_vline(xintercept = mean_post, linetype = 'dashed') + annotate('text', x = mean_post, y = 2.5, label = sprintf('mean = %.3f', mean_post), vjust = -0.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, angle = -90) + scale_x_continuous(limits = limits) + coord_flip() + theme_void()
plot <- top + plot_spacer() + scatter + right + plot_layout(ncol = 2, widths = c(4, 1), heights = c(1, 4))
save_panel(plot, 'Supplementary_Figure_12G_spatial_imputation.pdf', 5, 5)

```

## Visium imputation examples

```{r prepare_imputation_examples}

section <- objects[[sid]]
pseudospots <- aggregated[[sid]]
section <- subset(section, cells = intersect(colnames(section), paste0(sid, '_', colnames(pseudospots$data))))
plot_inputs <- list()

```

```{r plot_imputation_examples}

for (gene in c("CD3G", "PTTG1")) {
    xenium_values <- setNames(as.numeric(pseudospots$data[gene, ]), paste0(sid, "_", colnames(pseudospots$data)))
    values <- list(Xenium = xenium_values[colnames(section)], Pre_MAGIC = pre[gene, colnames(section)], Post_MAGIC = post[gene, 
        colnames(section)])
    for (modality in names(values)) {
        scale <- quantile(values[[modality]], 0.999)
        section[[modality]] <- setNames(pmin(1, as.numeric(values[[modality]])/scale), colnames(section))
        plot_inputs[[paste(gene, modality)]] <- data.frame(spot = colnames(section), patient = patient, gene = gene, 
            modality = modality, scaled_expression = section[[modality]][, 1])
    }
    panels <- SpatialFeaturePlot(section, features = names(values), pt.size.factor = 6, image.alpha = 0.4, combine = FALSE)
    panels <- lapply(panels, function(plot) plot + scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0, 1)) + theme(plot.title = element_blank(), legend.position = "none"))
    panel <- wrap_plots(panels, nrow = 1) + plot_annotation(title = gene, subtitle = patient, theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, 
        face = "bold", size = 14), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10)))
    letter <- if (gene == "CD3G") 
        "H"
    else "I"
    save_panel(panel, paste0("Supplementary_Figure_12", letter, "_", gene, ".pdf"), 5, 4)
}
write.csv(bind_rows(plot_inputs), file.path(result_dir, "Supplementary_Figure_12HI_plot_inputs.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

## Visium angiogenesis-associated genes

```{r select_angiogenesis_genes}

assignment <- analysis$metaprograms$assignment
trajectory <- analysis$trajectory
trajectory <- trajectory[match(assignment$spot, trajectory$spot), ]
genes <- c('NRP1', 'FGFR1', 'VEGFA', 'POSTN', 'COL3A1', 'COL5A2')
expression <- as.matrix(assemble_section_expression(objects, genes = genes, spots = trajectory$spot))
z <- t(scale(t(expression)))
groups <- list(MES = assignment$mesenchymal_invasive, 'Nevus-like' = assignment$nevus_like_senescence)

```

```{r summarize_angiogenesis_expression}

profiles <- lapply(names(groups), function(group) {
    member <- groups[[group]]
    data.frame(gene = genes, group = group, n = sum(member), mean_z = rowMeans(z[, member, drop = FALSE]), mean_SCT = rowMeans(expression[, 
        member, drop = FALSE]), fraction_detected = rowMeans(expression[, member, drop = FALSE] > 0))
})
profiles <- bind_rows(profiles)
write.csv(profiles, file.path(result_dir, "Visium_Discussion_angiogenesis_gene_profiles.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```

## Visium table composition inputs

```{r prepare_composition_summary}

weights <- weights[match(trajectory$spot, weights$spot), ]
counts <- spots$nCount[match(trajectory$spot, spots$spot)]
programs <- names(analysis$metaprograms$signatures)
lineages <- c('Melanoma', 'Lymphocyte', 'Myeloid', 'Endothelial', 'Fibroblast', 'Epithelial', 'Stroma')

```

```{r export_composition_summary}

summarise_group <- function(member, group, type) {
    data.frame(group_type = type, group = group, n_spots = sum(member), median_nCount = median(counts[member]), 
        as.data.frame(t(colMeans(weights[member, lineages, drop = FALSE]))), check.names = FALSE)
}
rows <- lapply(programs, function(program) summarise_group(assignment[[program]], program, 'Metaprogram'))
classes <- c('Shared Trunk', 'Lineage 1', 'Lineage 2')
rows <- c(rows, lapply(classes, function(class) summarise_group(trajectory$pt_class == class, class, 'Trajectory class')))
composition <- bind_rows(rows)
write.csv(composition, file.path(result_dir, "Visium_biological_group_composition.csv"), row.names = FALSE)

```
